name: North Topsail Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in North Topsail Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; golf carts depend on the town. In North Topsail Beach, LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. In Topsail Beach, LSVs may only cross North and South Anderson Boulevard.

golf_cart.notes: Check the town before you drive

lsv.notes: Topsail Beach: cross Anderson Blvd only

rules.rule: Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections
LSVs only cross North or South Anderson Blvd, except the 25 mph business district on S. Anderson

banned_roads.name: North and South Anderson Blvd (Topsail Beach)
banned_roads.rule: Cross only (except the 25 mph business district)

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Anderson Boulevard?
faq.a: In Topsail Beach, only to cross it, except the 25 mph business-district stretch of South Anderson.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in North Topsail Beach?
faq.a: Golf carts are allowed only where the town's ordinance permits them. Check with the town police first.
